title: 프로필 정의
description: Preflight panel > Define Profiles: the document's profiles, edited one at a time (`profile`: its place in the list; none = a new profile) and saved together. The boxes are the profile's name, whether it is the working profile (`useAsActive`), one box per rule of the engine's list (`rule.<ID>`, on = checked) under its category with a box for the whole category (`category.<name>`), and the numbers (`param.<key>`). Picking another profile keeps what the boxes hold in the list. Setting `import` to true reads the profile file `path` (a JSON file of the project, relative to its root) as a new profile; setting `export` to true writes the profile in the boxes there. OK sends every profile and the working one (setPreflightProfiles); no two profiles may have the same name. `namePrefix` is the name a new profile is given.
